verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack shows a maintained changelog, release notes, or version history for model or API changes. Per-family model cards and a docs page describing Llama 3.1's new features are adjacent artifacts, not a followable change log. The axis applies to a model platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, model and API changes land in a maintained changelog or release notes I can follow
